thread:
incident-bot: P1 alert — cassiopeia (dedicated/vpc-17) reporting spike in 5xx (gateway/internal) and tail latency since 09:12 UTC. Canary rollout artifact v4.0.0 showing errors for ~12% of requests from the tenant. PagerDuty: https://pd.redwood.example/incidents/RED-12345 :rotating_light:

ana-oncall: i'm on it. paging runtime and SRE. tagging @mike-runtime @devon-sre

devon-sre: saw the alert. i'm pulling logs from the dedicated pool now, looks like KV cache misses spiked during canary window. attaching quick grep output in a sec.

mike-runtime: joining. initial observability — model-serving 503s with "kv-cache-invalid" in logs for worker shards 3/8. cpu/gpu usage looks fine. suspect artifact v4.0.0 changed cache key format.

ana-oncall: alex from Cassiopeia SRE is in the call (cc @alex-customer-sre). priya, heads-up to CSM to prep a quick customer note.

priya-csm: on it. preparing a short note: "we're investigating increased errors during your canary, will update within 15 mins". can Alex confirm any client-side changes?

alex-customer-sre: no client-side changes. we rolled the canary per schedule and started seeing errors ~1m after traffic shift to canary. holding traffic now on our side.

mike-runtime: can we pin back pinned artifact on that VPC pool to v3.9.7? if v4.0.0 introduced key schema change we should revert the canary quickly.

devon-sre: agree. preparing to execute tenant pinback + staged rollback for cassiopeia on vpc-17. plan: 1) divert tenant traffic to fallback routing pool 2) pin tenant to v3.9.7 artifact 3) unroute canary artifact 4) monitor for 5xx drop.

ana-oncall: good plan. execute steps and post commands here. annotate times. switching incident to P1 and initiating on-call handoff if needed. @pagerduty-bot can you escalate to infra escalation policy?

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty escalation triggered to infra-escalation at 09:15 UTC — incident RED-12345. On-call: devon-sre, secondary: mike-runtime.

mike-runtime: running divert now. command:```
redwoodctl route divert --tenant cassiopeia --from-pool canary-vpc-17 --to-pool fallback-dedicated-2 --weight 100 --comment "emergency divert"
```

devon-sre: divert complete at 09:17 UTC. observed immediate drop in canary pool requests for cassiopeia. next: pin artifact.

mike-runtime: pin command issued:```
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant cassiopeia --pool vpc-17 --artifact v3.9.7 --force --reason "rollback after canary v4.0.0 caused 5xx"
```
Pin applied at 09:19 UTC.

devon-sre: unroute canary artifact and drain warm connections:```
redwoodctl artifact unroute --artifact v4.0.0 --pool vpc-17 --drain-secs 60
```
Issued at 09:20 UTC.

ana-oncall: monitoring metrics. earliest confirmation expected within next 3 minutes. @priya-csm prepare customer-facing timeline. @emma-product need a postmortem trigger for model onboarding process.

priya-csm: sending update: "We diverted traffic and pinned your tenant to the previous artifact (v3.9.7). We're continuing to monitor. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline." Sending now.

alex-customer-sre: thanks. we see errors drop on our side immediately after divert. can you confirm token-level logs show no 5xx after pin?

mike-runtime: checking token-level traces — sampling shows 5xx rate down from 12% -> 0.4% within 90s after divert+pin. tail latency back to baseline. attaching small log snippet:```
[09:12:15] cassiopeia req id=ab12.. status=502 kv-error=missing-key shard=3
[09:17:41] cassiopeia req id=cc34.. status=200 cache-hit=true shard=3
[09:19:22] cassiopeia req id=de56.. status=200 cache-hit=true shard=5
```

devon-sre: marking immediate mitigation successful. next actions: 1) create incident ticket with RCA template, tag runtime & model-onboard 2) keep tenant pinned until we validate new artifact on a non-prod mirror for customer 3) coordinate controlled re-rollout with model team.

emma-product: noted. lifecycle/process item: add mandatory model compatibility check for KV cache schema changes in onboarding runbook. assigning to @mike-runtime to draft change.

mike-runtime: will draft checklist items and add preflight check that runs schema-compatibility tests against a mirrored cache.

ana-oncall: handoff: i've stabilized the incident. handing to devon-sre for postmortem and next-day follow up. devon, you're POC for now. I'll remain available.

devon-sre: taking over. next update will be the incident ticket with timeline and logs. estimated follow-up in 2 hours with RCA summary for Cassiopeia.

priya-csm: i'll schedule a 30-min customer sync in 90 minutes to walk them through mitigation and next steps.

alex-customer-sre: appreciate the rapid response. please share the incident ticket link when ready.

incident-bot: Incident RED-12345 acknowledged as mitigated at 09:23 UTC (status: stable). Postmortem required: yes. Owner: devon-sre. Severity: P1.

ana-oncall: closing active paging. leaving channel for follow-up threads (postmortem, runbook changes). :white_check_mark:
